content.short: Matchain is the first AI-focused Layer 2 on BNB Chain.
content.description: Matchain provides a decentralized identity (DID) framework that addresses Web3 and AI challenges by removing data silos and giving users true ownership of their identities. It unifies fragmented identities across platforms and enables cross‑chain interoperability, improving usability for both Web2 and Web3 users. Built around an AI‑focused blockchain, Matchain emphasizes data privacy, reduces energy consumption, and makes AI more accessible by avoiding centralized control.
